payload.summary: FAIL. The current PR-168 artifacts pass their seven targeted tests and the read-only runner check, but the closeout implementation is not fail-closed. Three P1 integrity gaps allow stale acceleration consumers, vacuous manifests, or provenance-stripped normalized CAS results to be accepted; one P2 closeout-state gap accepts an explicitly pending affected-owner review. No production or shared file was edited.

claim_verdicts.reason: The reviewed code cannot yet establish a complete active-consumer migration or a hash/provenance-closed production closeout, even though the currently materialized evidence is green. This verdict does not dispute the frozen conditional exact-mechanics identity; it blocks the production migration closeout and PR status transition.

findings.title: The zero-stale gate can miss aliased, unlisted, and coefficient-renamed active acceleration consumers

evidence.detail: The governing contract requires zero active findings and explicitly names AST definitions/imports/aliases/references/calls plus the unsupported 3/4,1,3/14 coefficient signature.
For ast.alias the scanner records `asname or original-name`, so a from-import alias discards the forbidden original identifier.

Python AST scanning is restricted to prelisted `migration_required` rows; the only additional traversal is exact-string matching under docs/manuscript. No active-root discovery or coefficient-signature scan is implemented.
The registered stale-consumer mutation edits a finished report object instead of injecting a stale source through the real scanner, so it cannot kill this defect.
The acceptance test trusts the generated zero-finding status and mutation booleans; it supplies no alias, unknown-file, or coefficient-signature fixture.

findings.impact: An active caller can preserve the removed numerical ceiling through an aliased import, a new or omitted Python path, or the same coefficient triple under renamed symbols while the closeout reports zero stale findings. That defeats the production migration authorized by the conditional CAS result.
findings.required_change: Scan an explicit fail-closed set of active source roots, inspect both ast.alias.name and ast.alias.asname, detect the normalized unsupported coefficient signature, and reject unknown active paths. Drive the registered stale-consumer mutations through the real scanner with alias, out-of-inventory, and coefficient-renaming fixtures.

findings.title: An empty artifact manifest is vacuously accepted as hash-valid

evidence.detail: The frozen artifact contract requires provenance and input/config bindings for generated artifacts.
`_hash_bindings_valid` is `all(...)`; an empty mapping therefore returns True.
The writer has concrete required input and artifact sets, but these expected sets are not reused by the checker.
The closeout checker accepts missing/empty maps through `.get(..., {})` and never verifies the expected key sets.
The test checks only a metadata subset and iterates the manifest-provided maps, so both loops pass vacuously when the maps are empty.

findings.impact: The manifest can cease binding every scientific output and input while the read-only closeout gate and its acceptance test still report success.
findings.required_change: Define one canonical required input-key set and artifact-key set, require exact/nonempty equality in `_closeout_errors` and the test, and add missing-map, empty-map, extra-key, and removed-key mutations against the actual manifest validator.

findings.title: Post-collection CAS payloads can lose execution and provenance evidence and be rebound into a green closeout

evidence.detail: Initial collection correctly requires recorded commands/completion, verified inputs, redistribution success, no counterexample, exact source hashes, and independence fields.

The post-collection check revalidates only axis/status, contract hash, check booleans, and computed values; it neither reruns the deep validator nor compares current normalized hashes with the collection receipt.
The mutation baseline validator also omits commands, completion, verified input hashes, redistribution status, counterexample, and other deep-envelope fields.
`write_closeout` relies on the weaker post-collection check, then regenerates mutation evidence and a fresh manifest, allowing a modified normalized result to acquire new trusted hashes.
The targeted test checks status/evidence class/contract/domain/sibling/check booleans but not commands, completion, verified inputs, redistribution success, or counterexample absence.

findings.impact: After a legitimate blind collection, execution/provenance evidence can be erased or contradicted without invalidating the production closeout; `write-closeout` can then bind the weakened result into a new manifest.
findings.required_change: Use one full normalized-axis validator for collect, check, mutation baselines, and closeout; compare every current normalized-axis hash to `normalized_axis_sha256` in the collection receipt; revalidate the bound outer envelope and assignment where retained; and add post-collection mutations for every deep field.

findings.title: Closeout passes while the required affected-owner review is explicitly pending

evidence.detail: COMMON owns the card, HTT is the affected owner reviewer, and the output is internal C1/exploratory scope.
`affected_owner_review` is mandatory artifact metadata.
The manifest writer hardcodes `affected_owner_review` to `pending_pr168_adversarial_review`.
The closeout checker never rejects the pending value or requires a hash-bound review receipt.
The test does not include `affected_owner_review` in its required metadata set and does not validate review state.

findings.impact: The machine-readable closeout can claim success before the affected HTT owner review has been accepted and bound, so status consumers cannot distinguish pre-review from reviewed output.
findings.required_change: Represent review as a separate result/receipt with reviewer role, verdict, context version, path, and SHA-256; require an accepted value and exact receipt binding before closeout; propagate the accepted review metadata into the result card and manifest.

baseline_commands.outcome: pass; all hashes matched the assignment

assumptions: The assignment was executed read-only except for this unique declared result envelope.
No sibling assignment result was inspected; adversarial probes exercised the assigned runner in memory against the current published closeout artifacts.
The existing dirty worktree and all production/generated files belong to the main writer and were not modified by this reviewer.
Severity is scoped to the internal PR-168 production migration and closeout gate; no observational, transfer, geometry, family-identification, or cosmological claim was assessed.
proposed_changes: Replace inventory-only stale scanning with a fail-closed active-root scanner that detects original aliased imports and the unsupported coefficient signature.
Make manifest validation require exact canonical nonempty input/artifact key sets.
Unify deep axis validation across collect/check/mutations and verify collection-receipt hashes after collection.
Bind an accepted affected-owner review receipt before closeout.
Convert report-object mutations into executable mutations against the real scanner, collector/checker, and manifest validator.
tests_to_run_after_patch: Targeted unit tests for aliased imports, a new active file outside the frozen migration rows, renamed 3/4,1,3/14 expressions, and unknown active paths.
Manifest mutations for empty/missing/extra input and artifact key sets.

Post-collection normalized-axis mutations for commands, completed_at, verified_input_hashes, redistributed_fixture_matches, counterexample, domain assumptions, sibling access, and collection-receipt normalized hashes.
The PR card smoke, DAG, claim-language, and registered broader closeout gates.
risks_and_kill_switches: Do not mark PR-168 completed or rewrite its affected-owner review as accepted while any P1 remains open.
Do not rerun CAS axes merely to address these harness defects; the findings concern post-collection production/closeout validation, not the frozen exact identity.
Do not weaken the conditional exact-mechanics claim ceiling or reinterpret the unavailable non-geodesic ceiling as numerical zero.
If a real active stale consumer is found, fail the migration and retire or explicitly legacy-allowlist it with pinned provenance before regenerating closeout artifacts.
artifacts_status_updates_needed: Patch the assigned runner and acceptance tests under the main-writer role.
Regenerate the stale scan, mutation report, integrity receipt, result card, and artifact manifest after the fixes.
Bind the fresh accepted adversarial-review result and rerun closeout before transitioning PR status or writing PR_DELTA completion language.
